description: This file defines the WinDnsSystemSettings structure and related functions for managing Windows DNS system settings, including DNS addresses, policies, and devolution settings.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Represents Windows DNS configuration including DNS addresses, search lists, domain, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Encapsulates devolution settings for DNS, including enabled status and level.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a DNS address from IPv6 stateless discovery.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves all configured DNS nameservers, excluding stateless discovery addresses.

methods.name: ReadWinSystemDnsSettings
methods.description: Reads DNS system settings from Windows registry and IpHelper, returning an optional settings object.
